# BOGOODSKI.dev

> BOGOODSKI.dev is the personal site of Steve Bogucki, an independent enterprise AI enablement advisor. He helps large, complicated, often regulated or public-sector organizations make AI actually usable: governed LLM access, RAG chatbot programs, AI software and vendor review, AI use-case lifecycles, cost visibility, and AI/ML training for executives and staff. "BOGOODSKI" is the phonetic pronunciation of "Bogucki" and his brand name across his running, DJ, and developer profiles.

Steve has spent recent years helping stand up AI services from the inside of a large, heavily regulated U.S. federal environment serving tens of thousands of users. Before that: software development, web development, BI, analytics enablement, product ownership, and enterprise platforms. He holds Cornell machine learning certification training. The site is a single page with deep-linkable sections (listed below). It was built openly with AI assistance (Claude Code); see the disclosure section.

Last updated: 2026-11-06

## Key pages and sections

- [Home](https://bogoodski.dev/): Overview of Steve Bogucki and enterprise AI enablement services
- [Full content as markdown](https://bogoodski.dev/llms-full.txt): The complete site text in one LLM-friendly file
- [Services](https://bogoodski.dev/#services): Seven service areas, from AI strategy to vendor review
- [Approach](https://bogoodski.dev/#approach): Operating model first, usable governance, usable access, demo-to-production
- [Technical toolbox](https://bogoodski.dev/#toolbox): RAG engineering, LLM gateways, governance, vendor review, ML fundamentals, agents
- [Experience](https://bogoodski.dev/#experience): Hands-on enterprise AI enablement in a regulated federal environment
- [FAQ](https://bogoodski.dev/#faq): Plain-English answers about enterprise AI enablement, RAG, LLM governance, and AI vendor review
- [About](https://bogoodski.dev/#about): Background, working style, and the name
- [Built with AI](https://bogoodski.dev/#built-with-ai): Transparent disclosure of how AI was used to build this site
- [Contact](https://bogoodski.dev/#contact): Email and LinkedIn

## Services

- [Enterprise AI Enablement Strategy](https://bogoodski.dev/#service-ai-enablement-strategy): Operating model, governance path, service catalog, ownership, roadmap
- [AI Use-Case Lifecycle Design](https://bogoodski.dev/#service-ai-use-case-lifecycle): Intake, triage, data readiness, governance checkpoints, build, deploy, monitor, sustain
- [LLM Access & Governance Patterns](https://bogoodski.dev/#service-llm-access-governance): API gateways, IAM, token management, approved models, cost visibility
- [RAG Chatbot Program Design](https://bogoodski.dev/#service-rag-program-design): Self-service or managed RAG programs grounded in approved enterprise knowledge
- [AI Software & Vendor Review](https://bogoodski.dev/#service-ai-vendor-review): Data controls, training claims, retention, residency, logging, security posture
- [Executive & Workforce AI Upskilling](https://bogoodski.dev/#service-ai-upskilling): Technically honest, approachable AI/ML training
- [Technical Product Advisory](https://bogoodski.dev/#service-technical-product-advisory): Translating between executives, engineers, security, and data teams
